sentences.en: This cuisine is seasoned to evoke the esprit of Paris.
sentences.zh: 这道菜调味以唤起巴黎的精神。

sentences.en: Add seasoning, seasoned oil, and chili, to the boiling water.
sentences.zh: 在沸水中加入调料、调味油和辣椒。

sentences.en: Why buy a bag of seasoned chickpeas for four dollars?
sentences.zh: 为什么要花四美元买一包风干鹰嘴豆？

senses.zh: 富有经验的;加佐料的;风干的v.给...调味;适应;风干;“season”的过去式和过去分词
